Definition: to shine, i.e. (by analogy) be (causatively, make) oily or gross
BiblicalUsage: Fat is the Bible's picture of a people grown sleek on God's gifts and forgetful of the Giver. Jeshurun waxed fat and kicked, Isaiah was told to make the heart of this people fat so they would not understand, and Jeremiah says of the wicked that they are waxen fat, they shine, and they judge not the cause of the fatherless.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that fatness is the sign of a people that has eaten God's blessings and forgotten His name.
